Esra Öztoprak serves as a Kvalitetskonsulent (quality consultant) and representative for the data controller at [[danibd|DANIBD]], the Danish National Inflammatory Bowel Disease Register, as part of the steering committee [^src1]. Her role connects quality assurance and data governance functions within [[rkkp|RKKP]], the organization managing the register's operations.

The DANIBD steering committee, documented in the 2023 annual report, brings together representatives from medicine, surgery, nursing, and patient advocacy across Denmark's five regions, supported by epidemiological and data management expertise from RKKP [^src1]. During the period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, the register tracked treatment data for 33,381 patients with inflammatory bowel disease across these regions, with biologics administered to 10,523 patients [^src1].

No further details about Öztoprak's background, career history, or activities outside this steering committee role are available in the corpus.
